subject.title: ignoreFileContent setting not working - file content still sent to model as context

question: Should Feishu gain a supported attachment-context opt-out, and should it be a Feishu-specific setting or part of a shared channel attachment policy?
rationale: The reported key is not a current documented config contract, and adding it creates new channel config/default behavior that affects existing media ingestion.

options.title: Add Backward-Compatible Feishu Opt-Out
options.body: Add a documented top-level/per-account Feishu option that defaults to current download behavior and sends placeholders only when disabled.

options.title: Use A Shared Channel Policy
options.body: Design one canonical attachment-ingestion policy across channels if maintainers want iMessage, Feishu, and future plugins to share behavior.

options.title: Document Unsupported Key
options.body: Keep current media behavior and document that Feishu supports `mediaMaxMb` but no file-content ignore switch today.

recommendation.title: Add Backward-Compatible Feishu Opt-Out
recommendation.body: Add a documented top-level/per-account Feishu option that defaults to current download behavior and sends placeholders only when disabled.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Feishu media hardening makes this the closest available routing signal for the attachment policy choice.
